answer:
You should use **`VectorStoreIndex`**, imported from `llama_index.core`. The docs show building it from your loaded documents with `from_documents`:

"The simplest way to use a Vector Store is to load a set of documents and build an index from them using `from_documents`:" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/indexing/vector_store_index.md]

```python
from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex

index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(documents)
```

The same guide notes that `from_documents` splits your Documents into chunks and parses them into `Node` objects. The indexing guide also says you can build the index from a list of Node objects directly with `VectorStoreIndex(nodes)` [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/rag/indexing/index.md].
